description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the `LOTTERY_DB_PATH` environment variable requirement (the primary env var listed in metadata). A distractor file (`config/env_example.txt`) mentions a wrong variable name `LOTTERY_DB`. The agent must use the correct name `LOTTERY_DB_PATH`. 2. The agent must locate the SQLite database at `lottery-predictor-v3-8/data/lottery_history.db` (the only DB file in the workspace). 3. The agent must set `LOTTERY_DB_PATH` to point to this DB, then run `python3 lottery-predictor-v3-8/scripts/v3.8_ml_model.py` and capture output to `prediction_result.txt`. 4. The agent must separately run `python3 lottery-predictor-v3-8/scripts/backtest_v3.8.py 1000` (with the 1000-period argument per SKILL.md usage) and capture output to `backtest_result.txt`. 5. The prediction output must follow the exact V3.8 format with 【红球推荐】 (6 balls, range 1-33) and 【蓝球推荐】 (1 ball, range 1-16). 6. The backtest output must show the V3.8 回测报告 with 1000-period results including red/blue hit rates and model config (RandomForest 100 trees, GradientBoosting, ML 50% + rules 50%). The proprietary trap is the `LOTTERY_DB_PATH` env var name (not `LOTTERY_DB` or `DB_PATH`) and the bespoke 2-script architecture separating prediction from backtest.
